yokosuka_basic_11.direction: Chiba / Kimitsu / Narita Airport end → Kurihama end; TCF is at the Chiba end
yokosuka_basic_11.name: E217 Yokosuka–Sōbu Rapid Line 11-car basic set
yokosuka_basic_11.note: Arranged in real-world car order 11→1. Cars 9 and 3 each have one pantograph at the Kurihama end. The real-world double-deck Green Cars (Car 4 and 5) use the standard T car appearance. Car 11 retains the original TCF interior; its semi-cross seating is not reproduced. Cars 9 and 10 use the intermediate-car template with semi-cross seating.
limitations: The real-world double-deck Green Cars (Car 4 and 5) are represented by standard single-deck T cars.
In reality, Car 11 should be a cab car with semi-cross seating; the original TCF interior is retained.

yokosuka_attached_4.direction: Chiba / Kimitsu / Narita Airport end → Kurihama end; TCF is at the Chiba end
yokosuka_attached_4.name: E217 Yokosuka–Sōbu Rapid Line 4-car attached set
yokosuka_attached_4.note: Arranged in real-world attached-set car order 4→1. Attached-set Car 3 has one pantograph at the Kurihama end. All cars have longitudinal seating.
limitations: Subseries-specific details, such as toilets in the attached-set cab cars, use the original model and are not modeled separately.

limitations: The real-world double-deck Green Cars (Car 4 and 5) are represented by standard single-deck T cars.
